evals.prompt: Enumerate the mandatory legal and security header checks required before launching a web application to production.
asserts: Identifies Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and GDPR cookie consent
Specifies HSTS, CSP Level 3, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
Includes accessibility statement and error monitoring

evals.prompt: Explain how to structure an llms.txt file and configure robots.txt for AI agents and search crawlers.
asserts: Specifies llms.txt structure with H1 title, blockquote summary, and clean markdown links
Differentiates search crawlers from AI search bots and training scrapers in robots.txt

evals.prompt: Detail the Core Web Vitals thresholds and explain how to optimize Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Interaction to Next Paint (INP).
asserts: Recommends fetchpriority='high' and preloading hero images for LCP
Recommends task chunking and breaking long tasks for INP

evals.prompt: Show the RFC 9457 Problem Details error response format and explain how to enforce API latency SLOs.
asserts: Returns application/problem+json with type, title, status, and detail
Mentions p50, p95, and p99 latency budgets
Includes Idempotency-Key support for mutating endpoints
